name: Pavithra Nkosi-Czerwiński
description: A Tamil-Polish forward for the Lakeshore Vanguard FC who became the dominant offensive player in the GRAVBALL CONTINENTAL Premier Division between 2210 and 2218, known for a playing style that combined sanctioned reflex-enhancement BCIs with an almost preternatural spatial awareness that coaches describe as 'geometric intuition.' Her 2215 season — forty-seven goals in thirty-two matches, a record that stood for six years — was broadcast across all tiers and her celebration gesture, both fists crossed at the wrists, became a city-wide shorthand for personal triumph. She is widely credited with reviving Lakeshore Vanguard's fanbase after the franchise's near-collapse in the late 2200s.
story_hooks: The performance director who was terminated contacts a journalist claiming the spatial BCI overlay was not an isolated incident but part of a systematic Axiom-authorized program across three franchises — and that Nkosi-Czerwiński was not the only player affected.

A Tier 1 street gravball league wants to use Nkosi-Czerwiński's name to legitimize their underground circuit, but doing so would require her to break her Axiom endorsement contract — and the contract has an unusual personal liability clause.

Someone is selling bootleg copies of Nkosi-Czerwiński's leaked BCI calibration data on the Shelf, and underground augmentation surgeons are attempting to replicate the overlay for non-athletic clients.
